need: Verify the public catalog continuously and publish its deterministic static artifact without a hosted application, personal credential, or unattended GitHub curation mutation.

discovery.stop_condition: GitHub's native Pages artifact flow supplied a repository-scoped static deployment while the same build remained independently verifiable on pull requests and schedules.

contenders.name: gh-pages branch publishing
evidence: duplicates the native Pages artifact boundary

hard_gates: all Actions pinned to full commits
pull requests build but never deploy
only the deployment job receives pages and OIDC write permissions
scheduled upkeep receives contents read only
no personal token, model call, analytics, or GitHub star/List mutation
strict build and offline site verifier pass before artifact upload
unknowns: Scheduled runs may be delayed and may be disabled after repository inactivity.
The live Pages URL remains unverified until the workflow is enabled on main and its first deployment completes.
decision_effect: Use one pinned workflow to verify every proposed catalog change, retain a manifest on scheduled/manual upkeep runs, and deploy only a verified main-branch artifact through GitHub Pages.
reconsider_when: An official action release changes its permission or runtime boundary
Pages cannot serve the deterministic artifact without runtime network dependencies
Scheduled verification needs private evidence or a personal credential
